combo_tournament_winners#cb_dependence_s.description: The size of the cross-surface covariance and event-to-event carryover cannot be estimated precisely: consecutive major pairs for the same player are few (tens of cases), so confidence intervals are wide.
combo_tournament_winners#cb_dependence_s.what_would_resolve: Pool across surfaces and tours with hierarchical shrinkage and report uncertainty bands.

combo_tournament_winners#cb_environment_.description: Event-level pace and altitude (ten.venue_speed_history, from event hold history) and the weather correlation between simultaneous men's and women's events are attached as proxies, but no verified per-event pace index or weather archive tied to match times was found, so the environment link between legs is only roughly sized.
combo_tournament_winners#cb_environment_.what_would_resolve: Add event pace and weather inputs from the tournament and weather sources and test for cross-tour dependence.

combo_tournament_winners#cb_no_series.description: KXATPWTA (men's-plus-women's pairing at the 2027 Australian Open) is the only live series and has rules text; the source of truth is not named, and whether same-player or same-draw combinations will be listed (which would make the context same-player inputs relevant) is unknown.
combo_tournament_winners#cb_no_series.what_would_resolve: Monitor new KXATPWTA-style listings and their rules; confirm the settlement source in the full rules.

combo_tournament_winners#cb_sackmann_acc.description: The cross-surface covariance, slam carryover and health-persistence inputs list the Sackmann tennis_atp/tennis_wta CSVs (surface column, results) and tennis-data.co.uk; on 2026-11-07 their raw README paths returned HTTP 404 (tennis-data.co.uk 403) from the review sandbox, and Tennis Abstract surface Elo is a scrape of unknown terms, so the surface-covariance estimate has no verified free source; consecutive-major pairs are in any case only tens of cases (cb_dependence_size).
combo_tournament_winners#cb_sackmann_acc.what_would_resolve: Confirm the Sackmann files or a mirror from an unrestricted network and the Tennis Abstract terms, or name a replacement for surface-split ratings.

exact_set_score#es_dependence_estimation.description: The size of between-set dependence is not identified from set scores alone; separating latent form from momentum needs point-level data that exist for Slams only.
exact_set_score#es_dependence_estimation.what_would_resolve: Fit dependence on Slam point-by-point and test transfer to tour events with Sportradar or Stats Perform point data.

exact_set_score#es_retire_tail.description: The retirement sentence is truncated at 'based on play already co...' in both sampled exact-score rules, so how a retirement settles the rungs that cannot be decided unconditionally is not visible.
exact_set_score#es_retire_tail.what_would_resolve: Retrieve the complete rules_secondary text and settlement history of any retired matches in the series.

exact_set_score#es_sackmann_access.description: The straight_set_share_curve, retirement_timing_profile, within_match_dependence and set_first_server_sequence inputs rely on the Sackmann tennis_atp/tennis_wta score-string CSVs and on tennis_slam_pointbypoint. On 2026-11-07 the resolver got HTTP 404 for the tennis_atp, tennis_wta and tennis_slam_pointbypoint raw README paths (tennis_MatchChartingProject README returned 200), so neither the score-string source nor the Slam point-sequence source is verified; the between-set dependence parameter, identified only from point data, therefore has no verified primary source (Charting Project coverage skews to prominent players).
exact_set_score#es_sackmann_access.what_would_resolve: Obtain the repos or a mirror from an unrestricted network and record years, tours and fields; confirm Match Charting Project row counts by round and player prominence; otherwise cost a paid point-level feed (Sportradar/Opta, field lists unverified).

exact_set_score#es_toss_info.description: The toss (first server of set one) is public only shortly before play, and no free historical archive of toss outcomes was verified.
exact_set_score#es_toss_info.what_would_resolve: Capture the toss from live scoring feeds or buy Sportradar point-by-point with serve-order fields.

game_winner_inplay#gw_ball_effect_unveri.description: The new-ball effect on hold probability and the event-specific ball-change schedules were not verified from a source; sign and magnitude are hypotheses.
game_winner_inplay#gw_ball_effect_unveri.what_would_resolve: Estimate from point-by-point game sequences with ball-change schedules from rulebooks.

game_winner_inplay#gw_latency_unmeasured.description: The relative timing of Kalshi's settlement source and publicly visible feeds is not measured anywhere in the repository; the latency channel is described but cannot be sized.
game_winner_inplay#gw_latency_unmeasured.what_would_resolve: Run a prospective timestamped capture of at least two feeds and the Kalshi quote stream during live matches.

game_winner_inplay#gw_listing_time.description: The sampled markets name late games (game 10 of set 1, game 6 of set 4) in qualifying matches, but the rules do not say when the market is listed (before the match, before the set or during the set), so the share of the price that is existence risk versus the hold/break probability cannot be fixed from the text.
game_winner_inplay#gw_listing_time.what_would_resolve: Market open_time versus match start time and set start times for a sample of archived S1-S5 markets.

game_winner_inplay#gw_no_rules.description: Rules text now exists for KXATPS1GWINNER, KXATPS2GWINNER, KXATPS3GWINNER and KXATPS4GWINNER, but it is silent on a named game that is never reached (set ends before game N or set M not played), on whether the tiebreak counts as game 13, and the retirement sentence is cut off at 'unconditionally settled based on p'; a set-4 market (KXATPS4GWINNER) was listed on a best-of-three qualifier where set 4 cannot occur. KXATPGWINNER and KXATPS5GWINNER remain title only.
game_winner_inplay#gw_no_rules.what_would_resolve: Full rules_secondary for one S1-S4 market and the rules for KXATPGWINNER/KXATPS5GWINNER; archived settlements of markets whose named game was not played.

game_winner_inplay#gw_sackmann_access.description: The in-match spw prior strength k, ball-change and side-asymmetry calibration and the pair prior all depend on Sackmann's tennis_slam_pointbypoint and tennis_atp/tennis_wta files. On 2026-11-07 the resolver got HTTP 404 for those raw README paths (tennis_MatchChartingProject README returned 200), so the free point-sequence source for calibrating k is unverified; the only fallbacks named are paid vendors whose field lists were not verified.
game_winner_inplay#gw_sackmann_access.what_would_resolve: Retrieve the repos or a mirror from an unrestricted network and confirm point-level fields (server, game score, point winner) and years; confirm Match Charting Project row counts; otherwise obtain a vendor field list (Sportradar/Opta).

match_winner#mw_coverage_title_only.description: After archived rules were recovered only KXATPGAME and KXWTAGAME ('ATP/WTA Tennis Winner') remain title only. The single-match texts that exist (KXATPMATCH, KXWTAMATCH, Challenger, doubles, exhibition) carry no retirement sentence, and the eight round-winner series carry no secondary text at all, so walkover and retirement treatment is unstated for them.
match_winner#mw_coverage_title_only.what_would_resolve: Fetch rules for KXATPGAME/KXWTAGAME and full rules_secondary for one round-winner market; archived settlements of retired or walkover matches.

match_winner#mw_doubles_format.description: KXATPDOUBLES, KXATPCHALLENGERDOUBLES and KXWTADOUBLES doubles series settle a pair, but the scoring format (no-ad, 10-point match tiebreak in place of a third set) differs by tour and by Challenger/tour level; the Challenger doubles text (now recovered) does not state the format either; ten.format must be coded per event rather than per tour.
match_winner#mw_doubles_format.what_would_resolve: Per-event format register (ATP/WTA rulebooks, tournament pages) plus the Kalshi rules text for the Challenger doubles series.

match_winner#mw_misfiled_series.description: Whether title-only KXATPGAME and KXWTAGAME are single-match winners or outrights is unverified. KXTENNISEXHIBITION now has rules identical to tour matches, but exhibition formats (match tiebreaks, effort) are not described. The eight round-winner series filed here are the same object as KXATPIWO/KXATPIT/KXATPMCO in tournament_winner_futures.
match_winner#mw_misfiled_series.what_would_resolve: Fetch live rules_primary for KXATPGAME and KXWTAGAME and align the round-winner series filing across the two archetypes.

match_winner#mw_retire_clause.description: The sampled match-winner rules (KXATPMATCH, KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH, KXWTADOUBLES) end after the postponement sentence with no retirement sentence, while set/game/totals variants carry a retirement clause. Whether a retired match settles to the opponent is unstated.
match_winner#mw_retire_clause.what_would_resolve: Full current rules PDF or exchange rule filing for the winner series; archival settlement outcomes for retired matches.

match_winner#mw_round_winner_terms.description: The round-winner series ('If Jack Draper is a 2025 winner of the final of ATP Madrid') have only a primary sentence: listing time relative to the draw, a walkover in or before the named round, a retirement in it, and the source of truth are not stated.
match_winner#mw_round_winner_terms.what_would_resolve: Full rules_secondary and market open_time for archived KXATPMAD/KXWTAIWO-type markets versus draw publication time.

match_winner#mw_sackmann_access.description: Every primary rate/rating input here (surface_rating, opp_adjusted_serve_return, level_transfer_offset, doubles_pair_strength) names the Jeff Sackmann tennis_atp/tennis_wta CSVs. On 2026-11-07 the resolver re-tested raw.githubusercontent.com paths: tennis_atp, tennis_wta, tennis_slam_pointbypoint and tennis_misc README files returned 404 while tennis_MatchChartingProject README and a control repo returned 200; tennis-data.co.uk returned 403. Whether this is a sandbox/proxy restriction or removal of the repos is unknown; ITF/futures serve-count coverage and an 'atp_matches_doubles' file are also unverified.
match_winner#mw_sackmann_access.what_would_resolve: Fetch the repos or a dated mirror from an unrestricted network and record column lists, years and level coverage (tour, Challenger, ITF, doubles); otherwise name a replacement (Tennis Abstract scrape, Opta/Sportradar paid) per dataset.

match_winner#mw_speed_index_source.description: A public per-event court pace index (CPI or Hawk-Eye ball-speed) was not verified; the proposed player_speed_slope substitutes event-level hold% and ace-rate, which mixes court speed with field composition.
match_winner#mw_speed_index_source.what_would_resolve: Obtain ITF Court Pace Rating by event or Hawk-Eye bounce data and check that it is available as-of before each event.

match_winner#mw_wo_vintage.description: The walkover hazard can only be estimated historically as a day-level rate by round/tier/rest from score strings marked W/O; a W/O score carries no timestamp of when the withdrawal became public, so P(WO) at T-48h/T-12h/T-2h has no free historical source. Note that the sampled rules settle a pre-start walkover at a fair price, so this hazard changes market lifetime and fair-price exposure rather than Yes/No payoff.
match_winner#mw_wo_vintage.what_would_resolve: Own-capture ATP/WTA order-of-play and entry-list snapshots at fixed horizons for a season, or a paid feed with withdrawal timestamps (Sportradar/Opta; field list not verified).

nationality_and_team_futures#nt_designat.description: The rules say nationalities 'reflect those designated by the Governing League' but do not say whether that is the draw-sheet flag, the ATP/WTA player profile or the passport; if these differ (neutral athletes, switched allegiance) the settlement membership of a player is ambiguous, and no source gives a base rate for designation changes within an event.
nationality_and_team_futures#nt_designat.what_would_resolve: Kalshi clarification or a named source in the full rules text; a dated register of draw-sheet versus profile flags for past majors to size the discrepancy rate.

nationality_and_team_futures#nt_neutral_.description: The rule defers to nationality 'designated by the Governing League', but the treatment of players competing as neutral athletes or with changed allegiance is not visible and can matter for small national groups.
nationality_and_team_futures#nt_neutral_.what_would_resolve: Obtain the league's designation policy and examples of players with neutral status.

nationality_and_team_futures#nt_no_live_.description: The three live series here (KXATPNATWINNER, KXATPNATSTAGE, KXWTANATSTAGE) have rules text, but none states whether a compatriot who reaches the named round and then withdraws (or advances by walkover) counts, and no team-competition series was found, so team advancement rules remain inferred.
nationality_and_team_futures#nt_no_live_.what_would_resolve: Full rules or settlement precedents for a withdrawal after reaching the round, and the rules of any team-competition series once listed.

nationality_and_team_futures#nt_sackmann.description: Draw/nationality history and the home-Slam depth prior list the Sackmann tennis_atp/tennis_wta CSVs (nationality column) as free source; on 2026-11-07 their raw README paths returned HTTP 404 from the review sandbox, so the nationality field and Slam draw history are unverified, with Wikipedia draw pages as the only other named source.
nationality_and_team_futures#nt_sackmann.what_would_resolve: Confirm the files or a mirror from an unrestricted network, or build the nationality history from ATP/WTA draw sheets.

nationality_and_team_futures#nt_team_dat.description: Structured, timestamped nomination lists and captain history for Davis Cup, BJK Cup and Laver Cup were not verified as machine-readable public sources.
nationality_and_team_futures#nt_team_dat.what_would_resolve: Check ITF nomination pages and whether past nomination lists are archived.

nationality_and_team_futures#nt_team_rol.description: Inputs for team contracts (team_tie_lineup_distribution, host_surface_selection, team_group_tiebreak_rules, team_event_structure) were authored for Davis Cup/BJK/United Cup/Laver Cup contracts that were not found in the ledger; their roles are context until such a series is listed, and the live evidence base for this archetype is the nationality winner and stage-count series only.
nationality_and_team_futures#nt_team_rol.what_would_resolve: A ledger or market listing showing at least one team-competition series with rules text, after which roles can be re-set.

player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_injury_.description: Serve-specific injury information (shoulder, wrist, abdominal) and in-event serve speed are not available from a free structured source; general availability and retirement risk are carried by ten.fitness, ten.withdrawal_signals and ten.retirement_base_rate, but nothing in the catalog captures serve-specific impairment.
player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_injury_.what_would_resolve: Capture event serve-speed statistics round by round and tag medical timeouts from live scoring data.

player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_no_cont.description: KXATPACES rules are now available (full-match 'at least N' ace count, truncated at retirement), but the statistics provider is not named, the postponement treatment is absent from the text, and no double-fault or match-total series exists, so double-fault inputs remain conditional.
player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_no_cont.what_would_resolve: Kalshi's named source for 'statistics officially completed and recorded' and the full rules_secondary; check whether double-fault series are listed.

player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_pair_co.description: A match-total aces or double-faults market sums two players' counts that share exposure (match length) and environment (wind, altitude, court); no input defines the cross-player correlation of residual counts after controlling for the shared exposure, so the match-total variance cannot be set from the per-player inputs.
player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_pair_co.what_would_resolve: Estimate the correlation of the two players' count residuals from historical match serve statistics after conditioning on service points and event, and test whether it differs by court speed.

player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_sackman.description: The primary rate inputs (ace_opp_adjusted, second_serve_risk_policy, service_points_scenario_mixture, player ace and double-fault counts) name the Sackmann tennis_atp/tennis_wta CSVs as the sole free source of w_/l_ ace, df and svpt columns. On 2026-11-07 their raw README paths returned HTTP 404 from the review sandbox (tennis_MatchChartingProject returned 200), ITF/futures serve-count coverage is unverified, direction data depend on the Charting Project (coverage skews to prominent players) and speed data on Hawk-Eye feeds that are unavailable_public, so serve_direction_mix_vs_returner and first_serve_speed_trend are effectively unsourced.
player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_sackman.what_would_resolve: Confirm the files or a mirror (columns, years, Challenger/ITF coverage) from an unrestricted network; measure Match Charting Project coverage by player; obtain a vendor field list for serve speed and direction (Sportradar/Opta).

player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_source_.description: Official ATP/WTA statistics, vendor feeds and broadcaster graphics may record different ace counts (let-cord and foot-fault handling); which one would be the settlement source was not verified.
player_aces_and_double_faults#ac_source_.what_would_resolve: Compare sources on a sample of matches and obtain the exchange's stated source.

retirement_walkover_participation#rp_ann.description: retirement_announcement_hazard needs a dated announcement for each retired player and an at-risk roster of active players; Wikipedia retirement lists and ATP/WTA bios were proposed but dates of announcement (versus last match) and complete coverage of players who did not announce were not verified.
retirement_walkover_participation#rp_ann.what_would_resolve: Sample 50 retired players' announcement dates against press archives and compare with Wikipedia fields to measure coverage and date error.

retirement_walkover_participation#rp_ann.description: For KXATPRETIRE the sampled note requires retirement 'effective immediately or prior to 2027', but how a statement of a future retirement date, a farewell season or a public hint is treated is not visible.
retirement_walkover_participation#rp_ann.what_would_resolve: Fetch the full rules and any clarifications; collect past announcements and note effective dates.

retirement_walkover_participation#rp_atp.description: KXATPRETURN settles on competing 'in an ATP Match' and its note says the US Open 'is part of the ATP Tour and therefore would count'; the sampled text never says whether ATP Challenger, Davis Cup/Laver Cup/United Cup ties, exhibitions, the Olympics or qualifying rounds count as an 'ATP Match', which changes the eligible-event set and the P(enter) product for any returning player.
retirement_walkover_participation#rp_atp.what_would_resolve: Kalshi clarification or the full rules text for the series, or settlement precedents for a return via Challenger or team-event matches.

retirement_walkover_participation#rp_com.description: KXATPCOMPETE says only 'competes in the ... tournament'; whether a walkover after the draw, a retirement after the first game, or an entry without playing counts is not stated in the sampled rules.
retirement_walkover_participation#rp_com.what_would_resolve: Exchange rules text for 'competes', and settlement history of cases with walkovers or first-game retirements.

retirement_walkover_participation#rp_led.description: Participation, return-by-date and retirement-announcement contracts share only a topic, not a mechanism; the survival-curve and hazard approaches differ and might be separate archetypes.
retirement_walkover_participation#rp_led.what_would_resolve: Split the archetype into participation, return and announcement sub-archetypes in the registry.

retirement_walkover_participation#rp_ree.description: ten.unretirement_reentry_status assumes a return-from-retirement notice period and that re-registration becomes public; whether the ITIA publishes its registered testing pool or notices, and the exact current notice period in the Tennis Anti-Doping Programme, were not verified.
retirement_walkover_participation#rp_ree.what_would_resolve: Read the current TADP/WADA Code return-from-retirement article and check ITIA publications for any public notice list.

retirement_walkover_participation#rp_sta.description: No structured free source records the reason a player is absent or the stated return timeline, and entry-list vintages are not archived publicly.
retirement_walkover_participation#rp_sta.what_would_resolve: Prospective capture of entry lists and a hand-coded statement log, or a paid news feed.

retirement_walkover_participation#rp_unr.description: KXWTASERENA has only a primary sentence: whether doubles, mixed doubles, WTA 125 events, Grand Slams or exhibitions count as 'any WTA official tournament', and whether a walkover or entry without playing counts as competing, are not stated.
retirement_walkover_participation#rp_unr.what_would_resolve: Full rules_secondary for KXWTASERENA or archived settlement reasoning for the series.

season_ranking_and_majors#sr_field_contr.description: KXATPGRANDSLAMFIELD and KXTENNISMAJORDJOKOVIC have no secondary text: the issuance-window start, treatment of a final decided by walkover or retirement, and the source of truth are not stated (all majors in both windows have been played, so the issue matters for re-listed versions).
season_ranking_and_majors#sr_field_contr.what_would_resolve: Full rules_secondary for both series or for a re-listed 2027 version.

season_ranking_and_majors#sr_finals_qual.description: KXATPFINALSQUAL and KXWTAFINALSQUAL now have rules text: Yes on qualifying, and Yes even if a qualified player does not compete. Still open: whether an alternate promoted after a withdrawal 'qualifies', the exact cut-off date, and the ATP Grand Slam champion exemption (a current-year major winner finishing 9-20 in the Race takes the 8th place, outside knowledge). ten.remaining_race_arithmetic's catalog measurement still says a withdrawn qualifier is replaced by the next alternate and leaves the Slam-champion rule unmodelled; for these contracts withdrawal after qualifying must not reduce the qualifier's P(Yes).
season_ranking_and_majors#sr_finals_qual.what_would_resolve: Read the ATP and WTA Finals qualification rulebook sections and Kalshi settlement precedents for alternates; amend the race-arithmetic measurement in the catalog accordingly.

season_ranking_and_majors#sr_issuance_ti.description: The major contracts open 'after Issuance'; the issuance time is not in the sample, so titles that occurred between issuance and today (and whether the player still holds 24 majors for the 25th contract) cannot be checked.
season_ranking_and_majors#sr_issuance_ti.what_would_resolve: Obtain the market's open time and the player's major count at that time.

season_ranking_and_majors#sr_snapshot_so.description: Whether ATP and WTA publish a list between the final event of the year and Dec 31, and which list a Thursday 12:00 PM ET snapshot would use, was not verified from published calendars.
season_ranking_and_majors#sr_snapshot_so.what_would_resolve: Check ranking publication dates for December in prior years and the league's year-end ranking policy.

season_ranking_and_majors#sr_sources_acc.description: The rankings history, Slam participation and bo5-premium inputs cite the Sackmann rankings and match files (tennis_atp/tennis_wta raw paths returned HTTP 404 from the review sandbox on 2026-11-07, unconfirmed whether proxy-specific) and ATP/WTA rankings archive pages whose scraping terms and historical depth were not checked; ranking publication dates are likewise unverified.
season_ranking_and_majors#sr_sources_acc.what_would_resolve: Confirm rankings-file availability and history from an unrestricted network, read the ATP/WTA site terms, and obtain a dated list of weekly publication dates for several December periods.

season_ranking_and_majors#sr_wta_model.description: The WTA tour has higher parity and faster turnover of top players; title concentration and the cumulative-count mechanism (not applicable) may differ, and the existing inputs have not been calibrated separately.
season_ranking_and_majors#sr_wta_model.what_would_resolve: Fit the concentration and participation hazards separately for the WTA with at least 10 years of Slam data.

set_and_game_spreads#sp_court_pace.description: No public per-event court-pace index was verified; ten.venue_speed_history (event hold and ace history from match data) is attached as the proxy but mixes court speed with field composition, and ten.court_cond carries only condition flags.
set_and_game_spreads#sp_court_pace.what_would_resolve: Add an event pace index (ITF Court Pace Rating or Hawk-Eye derived) with as-of availability, then link to hold_break.

set_and_game_spreads#sp_no_wta_series.description: Only ATP spread series (KXATPGSPREAD games, KXATPSSPREAD sets) have live rules; WTA, Challenger and the bo3 versions of the set spread were not seen, so tour-gender calibration is unverified for contracts that may be listed.
set_and_game_spreads#sp_no_wta_series.what_would_resolve: Re-run the series ledger with a live scan of WTA and Challenger spread tickers.

set_and_game_spreads#sp_retire_clause.description: The retirement clause in KXATPGSPREAD is truncated in the sample; it is not visible whether the spread settles on games played at retirement or is treated as unsettled when the strike could still be crossed.
set_and_game_spreads#sp_retire_clause.what_would_resolve: Obtain the full rules_secondary text and archived settlement outcomes of retired matches.

set_and_game_spreads#sp_sackmann_access.description: The hold-gap, margin-PMF calibration, win-margin conversion and retirement-margin inputs name only the Sackmann tennis_atp/tennis_wta files (w_svpt, w_1stWon, w_2ndWon, l_ columns, score strings) as free source, and the serial-dependence input needs Slam point sequences from tennis_slam_pointbypoint. On 2026-11-07 their raw README paths returned HTTP 404 from the review sandbox (tennis_MatchChartingProject returned 200) and tennis-data.co.uk returned 403, so none of these sources is verified.
set_and_game_spreads#sp_sackmann_access.what_would_resolve: Confirm the files or a mirror (columns, years, Challenger/ITF coverage) from an unrestricted network, or name a replacement source for score strings and serve counts.

set_and_game_spreads#sp_tiebreak_countin.description: KXATPGSPREAD says only 'game differential ... across the full match'; whether a set tiebreak is one game (7-6), whether a deciding 10-point match tiebreak counts as a game or is excluded, and how an advantage final set is counted are not stated, and the margin PMF depends on each choice.
set_and_game_spreads#sp_tiebreak_countin.what_would_resolve: The full rules text or a settled precedent where a deciding tiebreak or 7-6 set decided the strike.

set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events#ss_availab.description: General availability is carried by ten.fitness and ten.withdrawal_signals, but no free structured source records serve-specific impairment (shoulder, wrist, abdominal) or in-match medical timeouts with timestamps, so the hold-rate effect of a visible problem cannot be estimated historically.
set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events#ss_availab.what_would_resolve: Add pre-match injury news and an in-match medical flag with timestamp vintage.

set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events#ss_depende.description: The size of the between-set dependence that links tiebreak counts and sweeps cannot be identified from set scores; point-level data exist only for Slams.
set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events#ss_depende.what_would_resolve: Calibrate on Slam point-by-point and test the transfer to tour events with Sportradar or Stats Perform point data.

set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events#ss_no_live.description: The only series filed here, KXATPTIEBREAK, is title only with no rules text and no currently listed market; whether decider match tiebreaks count and how a retirement before any tiebreak settles cannot be read. The sweep series KXATPSETSWEEP has moved to tournament_winner_futures.
set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events#ss_no_live.what_would_resolve: Fetch live rules text for KXATPTIEBREAK (tiebreak definition, decider match tiebreak, retirement) and re-map it in the ledger.

set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events#ss_sackman.description: tiebreak_base_rate_by_event, player_set_drop_propensity, tiebreak_sweep_joint_table and the hold-uncertainty input rely on Sackmann score strings (tiebreak score in parentheses) and serve counts. On 2026-11-07 the tennis_atp/tennis_wta raw README paths returned HTTP 404 from the review sandbox and tennis-data.co.uk returned 403; tennis-data.co.uk is in any case tour level only, so Challenger tiebreak base rates have no verified source.
set_sweep_and_tiebreak_events#ss_sackman.what_would_resolve: Confirm the Sackmann files or a mirror from an unrestricted network, check tennis-data.co.uk Challenger coverage, or name a replacement for score strings with tiebreak annotations.

set_winner_and_any_set#sw_anyset_definit.description: KXATPANYSET ('ATP Any Set Winner') is title-only; whether it settles on the named player winning at least one set (one minus the opponent's straight-sets probability) or on another set-level event, and its retirement treatment, cannot be read.
set_winner_and_any_set#sw_anyset_definit.what_would_resolve: Fetch live rules_primary/rules_secondary for KXATPANYSET and confirm the set-level object and retirement treatment.

set_winner_and_any_set#sw_env_gap.description: No verified public per-event court-pace or wind index exists; ten.venue_speed_history (event hold history) and ten.court_cond are attached as proxies that mix court speed with field composition, and wind needs a forecast archive.
set_winner_and_any_set#sw_env_gap.what_would_resolve: Attach an event pace index and a wind/roof log with as-of availability.

set_winner_and_any_set#sw_sackmann_acces.description: set_number_calibration, set_count_distribution_by_edge and within_match_serve_decay list Sackmann score strings and point-by-point files as sole free source; on 2026-11-07 the tennis_atp/tennis_wta/tennis_slam_pointbypoint raw README paths returned HTTP 404 from the review sandbox (tennis_MatchChartingProject returned 200) and tennis-data.co.uk returned 403, and tennis-data.co.uk is tour level only (Challenger and WTA 125 coverage unverified).
set_winner_and_any_set#sw_sackmann_acces.what_would_resolve: Confirm the files or a mirror from an unrestricted network, check Challenger/WTA coverage of tennis-data.co.uk, or name a replacement.

set_winner_and_any_set#sw_unplayed_set.description: The rules text sampled does not say how a set contract settles when the named set is never played (a set 3 in a straight-sets match) or is interrupted by retirement; the truncated retirement sentence leaves both open.
set_winner_and_any_set#sw_unplayed_set.what_would_resolve: Full rules text and archived settlement outcomes for set-N contracts in matches that ended before that set.

total_games_and_sets#tg_court_pace_sourc.description: The ITF Court Pace Rating classifies surface products and tested courts, not necessarily the courts used at each event, and its public list was not verified as an event-level, as-of source (the same status as in set_and_game_spreads and player_aces_and_double_faults); event hold% is a contaminated proxy that mixes court speed with field composition.
total_games_and_sets#tg_court_pace_sourc.what_would_resolve: Check the ITF publication and Hawk-Eye based pace data for coverage and release timing.

total_games_and_sets#tg_match_tiebreak.description: The sampled text calls the quantity 'completed games in the full match' but does not say how an ordinary 7-point set tiebreak (one game, giving 13 for a 7-6 set), a Slam deciding-set tiebreak, a 10-point match tiebreak replacing a deciding set, or a super-tiebreak in an exhibition is counted; each convention shifts the total by up to several games.
total_games_and_sets#tg_match_tiebreak.what_would_resolve: Rules text and settlement history for any format with a match tiebreak.

total_games_and_sets#tg_retire_over_unde.description: Whether the over side settles Yes when the completed games already exceed the strike at retirement, and whether the under side is voided, depends on the truncated retirement clause in the sample.
total_games_and_sets#tg_retire_over_unde.what_would_resolve: Complete retirement sentence and archived retired-match settlements.

total_games_and_sets#tg_sackmann_access.description: games_per_set_distribution, player_games_residual and retirement_games_completed_profile name the Sackmann tennis_atp/tennis_wta score and serve-count files as the sole free source; on 2026-11-07 their raw README paths returned HTTP 404 from the review sandbox (tennis_MatchChartingProject returned 200) and tennis-data.co.uk returned 403, and tennis-data.co.uk is tour level only, so Challenger and WTA 125 totals have no verified source. The ITF Court Pace Rating list is a rating of surface products and tested courts, not a per-event pace series (see tg_court_pace_source).
total_games_and_sets#tg_sackmann_access.what_would_resolve: Confirm the files or a mirror from an unrestricted network, check tennis-data.co.uk Challenger coverage, or name a replacement for score strings and serve counts.

tournament_winner_futures#tw_inactive_pl.description: KXWTATOURNWIN names a retired player; the return-to-competition gate needs re-entry announcements and wildcard decisions with dates, for which no structured free archive exists (the retirement archetype defines a re-entry status input for this).
tournament_winner_futures#tw_inactive_pl.what_would_resolve: Own capture of comeback, testing-pool and wildcard announcements with dates; historical un-retirement cases coded manually.

tournament_winner_futures#tw_round_robin.description: The tie-break order and alternates rules for ATP Finals, WTA Finals and Next Gen Finals were not read from the rulebooks here, and the Next Gen format (short sets) is not modelled by the existing inputs.
tournament_winner_futures#tw_round_robin.what_would_resolve: Read the current event rulebooks and ingest group rules by year.

tournament_winner_futures#tw_sackmann_ac.description: round_upset_calibration, surface/venue and race inputs list the Sackmann tennis_atp/tennis_wta CSVs (seed and round columns); on 2026-11-07 their raw README paths returned HTTP 404 from the review sandbox (tennis_MatchChartingProject returned 200), and tennis-data.co.uk returned 403, so neither source is verified. Because tw_withdrawal_vintage also rules out timestamped entry history, withdrawal_cascade_effect can be weighted only by a day-level W/O rate drawn from those same unverified files.
tournament_winner_futures#tw_sackmann_ac.what_would_resolve: Confirm the files or a mirror from an unrestricted network (seed, round, W/O score fields, years, tour levels) or name a replacement; see tw_withdrawal_vintage for the own-capture route.

tournament_winner_futures#tw_sweep_and_r.description: KXATPSETSWEEP defers retirement, walkover, default and disqualification to 'official tournament advancement and scoring records' without saying whether a set in progress at retirement counts as dropped, and KXWTAROE does not say how a walkover received (not given) or a lucky-loser re-entry is placed. KXWTAROE also names a retired player (Serena Williams) and does not say how a player who never enters the tournament is settled (no elimination round exists).
tournament_winner_futures#tw_sweep_and_r.what_would_resolve: Archived settlements of sweep markets in tournaments with opponent retirements and of round-of-elimination markets with walkovers.

tournament_winner_futures#tw_title_only.description: Only KXATPMEN is still title only. Of the series with rules, KXATPFINALS, KXWTAFINALS, KXATPNEXTGEN and the six round-winner series have a primary sentence only, so the 'withdraws ... resolve No' wording of KXATP/KXWTA cannot be assumed for them, and lucky-loser replacement and a final decided by walkover are unaddressed.
tournament_winner_futures#tw_title_only.what_would_resolve: Fetch KXATPMEN rules and full rules_secondary for one Finals, Next Gen and round-winner market.

tournament_winner_futures#tw_withdrawal_.description: No free source archives entry list and draw states with timestamps, so withdrawal hazards by interval and the sensitivity of prices to withdrawal news cannot be estimated from history.
tournament_winner_futures#tw_withdrawal_.what_would_resolve: Own capture of entry lists and draws for a full season, or a vendor feed with change history.
